text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: KV cache continuous-batching regression detected on prod-cluster-3. Elevated cache size, paging, and packer queue growth. Automated mitigation not applied (thresholds exceeded).

morgan: seeing big tail spikes on /generate routes ~180s p95. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/shot/kv-cache-regress (links in thread).

chen: rolling up right now. Any customer-facing errors?

katie: some routes returning 504s, a handful of customers (acme-inc, betaapps) reported increased latency/timeouts. No total outage.

alejandro: eviction rate jumped 4x and packer thin queues starved short requests. Looks like continuous batching is piling large long-seq requests into packs -> pack blowout.

morgan: logs from packer svc: ```
[2026-03-15T03:12:02Z] packer: batch_size=1024 seq_len=2048 pack_time_ms=12000 outstanding_packs=48
[2026-03-15T03:12:05Z] evictor: evicted_keys=3421 cache_bytes=12.4GB -> 18.9GB
```

ops-bot: @oncall morgan paged (pagerduty): PD-7891.

morgan: triage notes: likely two interacting regressions: (1) prefetch loop misclassification for mixed-shape workloads, (2) packer fairness config not enforcing max_pack_latency for short reqs.

chen: immediate plan: 1) toggle continuous_batching=false on affected pool, 2) reduce pack_size and enforce max_outstanding_per_worker, 3) apply temporary route-level slow-path fallback to smaller-model-variant. I'll coordinate the hotfix rollout.

katie: will notify SRE on-call to watch paging / host memory. Also opening a customer impact note for Acme and BetaApps with support.

alejandro: hotfix PR ready: ```yaml
# packer config patch
continuous_batching: false
max_pack_size: 256
max_outstanding_per_worker: 8
fairness_time_threshold_ms: 50
```
PR: https://git.redwood/packers/patches/3456

morgan: applying to prod-cluster-3: staging -> canary (2 nodes) -> fleet. Starting canary now.

ops-bot: deploy started for commit 9b3f2a on prod-cluster-3 (canary).

chen: canary metrics look good so far (10m). Short-request p95 down from 180s -> 45s. Eviction rate trending down.

alejandro: enabling reduced pack_size everywhere now. Rolling patch to remaining nodes.

incident-bot: NOTE: page escalation timer paused by morgan.

katie: customer updates sent: "We're investigating increased latency; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up in 1 hour"

sophie: monitoring alert: paging events decreased but we still see sporadic tail spikes on mixed-shape routes. Is there a plan for permanent fix?

morgan: long-term: rollback the prefetch classifier change from last week, add regression test with mixed short/long traces, and tune packer to do per-route shaping. We'll open RFC and follow-up tasks.

chen: handing off to katie for post-mitigation watch and to own the customer comms. I'll be on standby for rollback if anything regresses. @katie you're oncall for next 30m.

katie: ack. I'll monitor dashboards and close PD when sustained.

ops-bot: PD-7891 status -> acknowledged by morgan, assigned to chen.

morgan: marking incident as mitigated for now :white_check_mark:. We'll keep a low-sev follow-up to finish root-cause and add automated guardrails to prevent pack blowouts.

alejandro: follow-ups created: RFC-1217 (prefetch classifier revert), TASK-8842 (pack-fairness e2e), MON-7001 (alert: packer_outstanding > 10 AND eviction_rate > 2x).

katie: customer note updated with final mitigation summary. Closing thread after 30m stable.

incident-bot: Incident timeline appended to incident DB. Please add any postmortem notes under /postmortems/kv-packer-prefetch-2026-03-15."
